quotes.text: I was really creating this collage, this very immersive experience that felt very grounded and very real and layered. I don't think you [usually] get that kind of approach, particularly for someone like my mom and that kind of music, and we really wanted to make it as personal and immersive as possible.
It was really coming to terms with not having my mom. I had just become a mother and I was really processing what that role was like.
I just felt like there was a lot to be said that wasn't said yet.
